messages:
maria: FYI ACME needs a 48h turnaround on their security questionnaire evidence bundle. They specifically called out: KMS access logs, RBAC change history, and an extract of audit logs for the last 90 days. Can eng-security own this and who can join the customer call Thu 10am PT?

dan: I can own the audit log extraction and packaging. Will need help with redaction rules and S3 presigned delivery method.

kevin: Quick Q — do they want raw CloudTrail-style logs or a filtered, indexed export for their SIEM? Sending raw could include customer data.

maria: Good point. I asked product: they want "evidence-friendly" exports (audit events around KMS keys + RBAC) — not full application payloads. We should create an indexed CSV + md5 manifest.

lena: For KMS usage, we can pull CloudTrail DataEvents and KeyUsage logs. Suggest this CLI snippet for the window: 
```bash
# example to query last 90 days via aws cli
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:... --start-time 2024-12-01 --end-time 2025-03-01 > kms-usage.json
```
We'll need reviewer for PII redaction step.

dan: I'll run the export and put raw outputs into a locked S3 bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/acme/<job-id> with kms:Encrypt. After redaction I'll generate a separate pack.

kevin: Redaction checklist: IPs hashed? user IDs replaced with stable pseudonyms? remove any customer prompt text. We have a redact tool: /scripts/redact-evidence --rules acme-sq. Who's running it?

maria: Oncall can run redact; dan will upload raw, oncall will produce redacted CSV and manifest. I can join customer call with product at Thu 10am PT.

oncall: ack. I have access to the redact runner and will schedule an hour Friday AM to run tests. Need service account creds and path to the ruleset.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-EVID-2026 to track tasks: extract KMS events, extract RBAC audit history, run redaction, produce manifest, generate signed delivery link. Assignees: dan, oncall, maria. ETA 48h.

maria: A few technical notes for the bundle: include key rotation events (CreateKey/RotateKey/DisableKey), PutKeyPolicy changes, and IAM policy change events. For RBAC history, export changes from our internal auth service: /admin/audit?v=changes (CSV).

dan: For the RBAC change history I can query the audit DB and include a policy diff per change. Output will be compressed and checksummed.

kevin: Also add a short readme describing redaction rules and who approved them. ACME's legal will want chain-of-custody and MD5/SHA256 hashes.

lena: One more: if we include CloudTrail CloudWatch logs, we should avoid sharing any Lambda env vars or function payloads. I'll add a filter to the extractor to drop "requestParameters.requestPayload" fields.

maria: Great. Action items: (1) dan: raw export to locked bucket (2) oncall: run redact and produce zipped bundle + checksums (3) lena: add extractor filters and redact rules (4) kevin: prepare readme and chain-of-custody note. I'll join the Thu call and present the artifacts.

oncall: Confirmed, will ask infra to provide temporary KMS key to encrypt the evidence bucket and rotate after delivery.

maria: Thanks all. If anything blocks before Wed EOD ping me directly. :thumbsup:
